settings.generationPreference.markdownDe:
You can generate preference by yourself. we set Intelligent Mode as default, which means that the plugin will intelligently generate the best completion based on you context, possibly by line or by block.

If you prefer to generate only by line, the plugin will generate one line of code at a time or complete the current line
settings.enableSmartTitle.markdownDescri: Enable AI-powered smart title generation for conversations. When enabled, a lightweight model automatically generates a short, descriptive title after each conversation's first Q&A round.
Enable Automatically formats the code generated by inline chat
settings.enableInlineChatIDEShortcutsTip: Enable IDE inline chat shortcuts tip (with Add to Chat feature)
settings.toolbarOnSelection.markdownDesc: Show toolbar when text is selected
settings.enableWorkspaceRules.markdownDe: Automatically read smart rules from the .rules directory
settings.planModeFirst.markdownDescripti: Once enabled, Craft will first analyze the requirements and then proceed to code generation after confirmation.

settings.modelDocumentLanguage.markdownD: Set the language in which comments are generated

settings.taskList.markdownDescription: Allow Agent to use Task lists to track progress on tasks.
settings.standaloneTerminal.markdownDesc: Use a standalone terminal process for command execution in agent mode. When disabled, falls back to the legacy terminal tool for systems with unsupported shell configurations.
settings.autoUpdateThirdPartyMarketplace: When enabled, checks for third-party marketplace changes (Git type) once a day and updates them silently in the background.
settings.requestMaxStepLimit.markdownDes: Maximum steps for the main Agent per conversation before auto-pausing. Set to 0 to disable the limit. You can reply "continue" to resume. Default is 2000.
settings.customAgentMaxStep.markdownDesc: Maximum steps for sub-agents (custom agents) per invocation. Set to 0 to disable the limit. Default is 2000.
settings.chatFontSizeMode.markdownDescri: The font size for the chat page. Font size is limited to 10-30 pixels.
settings.chatFontSize.markdownDescriptio: Controls the custom font size (in pixels) for the chat page. Only effective when chat font size mode is set to custom.
settings.enableImageGen.markdownDescript: Enable image generation feature. When enabled, the Agent can generate images based on text descriptions.
settings.enableLsp.markdownDescription: Enable the LSP (Language Server Protocol) tool for AI chat. When enabled, the Agent can use language intelligence features such as go-to-definition and find-references.
settings.enableCraftCodeBase.markdownDes: Enable the Codebase Search tool. When enabled, the Agent can use semantic code search to find relevant code across the entire codebase.
settings.enableCloudStudioTools.markdown: Enable Cloud Studio tools (deploy, sandbox commands, logs) for AI chat. Disabled by default. When enabled, the Agent can deploy the current project to Cloud Studio and manage sandbox environments. You can also enable it from the Integrations settings.
settings.safeDeleteEnabled.markdownDescr: When enabled, deletion operations performed by the agent (such as `rm`, `unlink`, `rmdir`, `Remove-Item`, `del`, `delete_file`) move files to the recycle bin (Trash) instead of permanently deleting them, and bulk deletions reaching the threshold require confirmation. When disabled, files are permanently deleted. Default: enabled.
settings.safeDeleteBulkThreshold.markdow: The number of files in a single deletion operation that triggers the bulk deletion confirmation dialog. The larger the value, the fewer confirmation prompts. Default: 500.
settings.HTTPProxy.description: Works when HTTP Proxy Mode is manual(VSCode version 1.74 and above is available)
settings.trustEnterpriseRootCa.descripti: Trust CA certificates from the operating system trust store, including enterprise root CAs installed by your administrator. Enabled by default, matching the behavior of your browser. TLS verification always stays fully enabled: expired, revoked, hostname-mismatched and untrusted certificates are still rejected. Turn this off only to troubleshoot problems caused by reading the OS trust store.
settings.endpoint.markdownDescription: Backend service endpoint. Once set, all requests will be sent to this address.
settings.selectedCompletionModel.markdow: The currently selected completion model ID. To select from a list of available models, use the __"Change Completion Model"__ command or open the model picker from the completions status bar menu. The value must be a valid model ID. An empty value indicates that the default model will be used.
shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
settings.autoRun.markdownDescription: When enabled, the model will automatically run commands without manual confirmation.
settings.disableBuiltInMarketplace.markd: When network cannot reach the built-in plugin marketplace (download.codebuddy.cn), enable this to skip marketplace installation and periodic update checks. Prevents chat requests from being blocked by repeated marketplace fetch timeouts. Equivalent to setting the `CODEBUDDY_SKIP_BUILTIN_MARKETPLACE` environment variable to `1`.
settings.autoModifyFile.markdownDescript: When enabled, the model will automatically modify files without manual intervention.
settings.terminal.commandTimeoutMs.markd: Maximum execution time (in milliseconds) for a single terminal command run by the agent. Defaults to `600000` (10 minutes). Increase it for long-running tasks such as builds or scripts. The environment variable `BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS` takes precedence over this setting.
settings.autoRunMode.askEveryTime.label: Ask Every Time
settings.autoRunMode.runEverything.label: Run Everything
settings.autoRunMode.markdownDescription: Choose how Agent runs tools like command execution, and file writes
settings.enableModelOptimization.markdow: Allow us to use your data for model optimization to improve product experience. We will take measures to protect your data.
settings.customBlacklistCommands.markdow: User-defined dangerous command blacklist. Each entry is a regular expression matched against the full command; matched commands will be blocked or require confirmation. Applied on top of the built-in security rules.
settings.disabledSecurityCategories.mark: Built-in security check categories to disable. All checks under a disabled category are skipped. Available values: `diskOps`, `windowsSystem`, `network`, `systemServices`, `userManagement`, `fileDelete`, `permissions`, `processControl`, `gitOps`, `injection`, `scriptExec`, `powershell`, `custom`.
